cards.ex: We've had a really nice spell of weather lately, all sunshine and blue skies.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi paytlarda ob-havo juda yaxshi bo'ldi, quyoshli va ko'k osmon.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havoning ma'lum bir turining qisqa vaqt davom etishi.

cards.ex: We're planning a picnic on Saturday, weather permitting.
cards.exUz: Shanba kuni piknik rejalashtiryapmiz, agar ob-havo imkon bersa.
cards.uzDef: Agar ob-havo yaxshi bo'lsa, amalga oshiriladi.

cards.ex: There's a definite nip in the air this morning; I'm glad I wore a scarf.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab havoda sovuq sezilyapti; men sharf taqqanimdan xursandman.

cards.ex: The town looked beautiful under a blanket of snow.
cards.exUz: Shahar qor qoplami ostida juda chiroyli ko'rindi.

cards.ex: It's been scorching hot all week; I can't wait for it to cool down.
cards.exUz: Hafta davomida juda issiq bo'ldi; sovuq tushishini kutaman.

cards.ex: The ground is bone dry after weeks without rain.
cards.exUz: Bir necha hafta yomg'irsiz o'tganidan keyin yer quruqshab ketgan.
cards.uzDef: Mutlaqo quruq, hech qanday namlik yo'q.

cards.ex: It's bitterly cold outside; make sure you wrap up warm.
cards.exUz: Tashqarida juda sovuq; yaxshilab o'ranib oling.

cards.ex: Hikers need to be prepared to face the elements in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Sayyohlar tog'larda yomon ob-havoga duch kelishga tayyor bo'lishlari kerak.

cards.ex: This storm came out of nowhere! We weren't expecting any rain today.
cards.exUz: Bu bo'ron kutilmaganda paydo bo'ldi! Biz bugun yomg'ir kutmagan edik.

cards.ex: There's a break in the clouds; maybe we'll get some sunshine after all.
cards.exUz: Bulutlar orasida tanaffus bor; balki biz baribir quyosh nurini olarmiz.
cards.uzDef: Bulut qoplagan osmonda quyosh nuri ko'rinadigan vaqt.

cards.ex: The old house had suffered from exposure to the elements over the years.
cards.exUz: Eski uy yillar davomida ob-havo ta'siridan aziyat chekkan.
cards.uzDef: Yomon ob-havo, masalan, yomg'ir, shamol yoki sovuq.

cards.ex: The fisherman's face was weathered and weather-beaten from years at sea.
cards.exUz: Baliqchining yuzi dengizda o'tgan yillari davomida ob-havo ta'sirida eskirgan.

cards.ex: The company's future is under a cloud due to the economic downturn.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy pasayish tufayli kompaniyaning kelajagi shubha ostida.

cards.ex: Chilly winds are blowing in from the north, so dress warmly.
cards.exUz: Shimoldan sovuq shamollar esmoqda, shuning uchun issiqroq kiyining.

cards.ex: We just had a dusting of snow overnight, nothing major.
cards.exUz: Bizda bir kechada ozgina qor yog'di, hech qanday jiddiy narsa yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Yuzasida juda yupqa qatlam hosil qiladigan qor.

cards.ex: Winter has really set in now; it's freezing every night.
cards.exUz: Qish haqiqatan ham boshlandi; har kecha muzlayapti.

cards.ex: The city is experiencing a heat wave with temperatures over 100 degrees.
cards.exUz: Shahar 100 darajadan yuqori harorat bilan issiqlik to'lqinini boshdan kechirmoqda.

cards.ex: A cold front is moving through tonight, bringing cooler temperatures.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun sovuq front o'tmoqda, sovuqroq harorat olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Sovuq ob-havoni olib keladigan atmosfera chegarasi.

cards.ex: The insurance company said the flood damage was an act of God.
cards.exUz: Sug'urta kompaniyasi suv toshqini zarari Xudoning ishi ekanligini aytdi.

cards.ex: The storm came out of the blue; we weren't expecting it at all.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron kutilmaganda keldi; biz buni umuman kutmagan edik.

cards.ex: He's a fair-weather friend; he's never around when I need help.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi kun do'sti; menga yordam kerak bo'lganda u hech qachon atrofda bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat yaxshi paytlarda do'st bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: The postman delivers the mail in all weathers.
cards.exUz: Pochtachi har qanday ob-havoda xatni yetkazib beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi yoki yomon ob-havo bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar.

cards.ex: The doctor suggested a change of climate for my health.
cards.exUz: Doktor sog'lig'im uchun iqlim o'zgarishini tavsiya qildi.

cards.ex: She was on cloud nine after getting the job.
cards.exUz: U ishga qabul qilinganidan keyin juda baxtli edi.

cards.ex: He's always chasing rainbows, dreaming of things that will probably never happen.
cards.exUz: U doimo armon ortidan quvishadi, ehtimol hech qachon ro'y bermaydigan narsalar haqida orzu qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Eriish qiyin bo'lgan orzularga erishishga urinish.

cards.ex: As the storm drew near, the skies grew dark and ominous.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron yaqinlashgani sari osmon qorong'i va xavfli bo'lib ketdi.

cards.ex: The wind is picking up; we should head inside.
cards.exUz: Shamol kuchaymoqda; biz ichkariga kirishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: We're hoping for a break in the weather so we can go hiking.
cards.exUz: Biz piyoda yurish uchun ob-havo tanaffusiga umid qilyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Yomon ob-havodan keyin yaxshi ob-havo davri.

cards.ex: We saw a sun shower this morning; it was quite beautiful.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun ertalab quyoshli yomg'irni ko'rdik; u juda chiroyli edi.

cards.ex: The fog was as thick as pea soup this morning; you couldn't see a thing.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab tuman no'xat sho'rvadek quyuq edi; hech narsa ko'rinmasdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda quyuq, odatda tuman haqida aytiladi.
